description: Source code implementing PDCCH aggregation level calculation, including functions for MCS configuration, code rate computation, and mapping CQI to aggregation levels within a 5G NR context.

methods.name: get_mcs_config
methods.description: Calculates Modulation and Coding Scheme (MCS) configuration based on CQI and MCS table.

methods.name: compute_pdcch_code_rate
methods.description: Computes the PDCCH code rate for a given aggregation level and number of DCI bits.

methods.name: does_dci_bits_fit_in_cces
methods.description: Checks if DCI bits fit within the CCEs of a specified aggregation level.

methods.name: fetch_mcs_table
methods.description: Selects the appropriate MCS table based on the CQI table.

methods.name: ocudu::map_cqi_to_aggregation_level
methods.description: Maps CQI to an appropriate aggregation level considering candidate configurations and DCI size.
